items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: I just hold for the cappella just for the trumpet. I just hold for the trumpet and Albert Burbing, the small artist, for the rest of the band.

ctx.x: What do you think of the different music places here in New Orleans? Have you seen the differences in the difference?

Also, I myself was only in three places. That was Preservation Hall, Dixieland Hall and Absinthe House. I was not in the paddock, because it was for me first to expensive. And since you can hear the music from outside and I also know who plays, I just hold for the cappella just for the trumpet. I just hold for the trumpet and Albert Burbing, the small artist, for the rest of the band. I don't like the band. I don't like the band. The Narwin Kimball Band in Old Absinthe House, the band has me very good. They are…
Thank you very much. I think that's it. The paper is running out anyway.
